Daise — Dollfaces & Charm Bracelets Clipping
Clip Influence Campaign Guidelines

Please make sure to follow the full list of clipping instructions. Any attempts at malicious clipping or other harmful behavior may result in immediate removal from the campaign and a permanent ban. If you have any questions or need further support, feel free to ask in the chat or DM an admin in the support chat.
TikTok and Instagram ONLY — Grown Theme Pages & UGC Creators ONLY (no Dedicated/Branded Pages for this campaign)
Campaign goal: Amplify viral noise around two key Daise SKUs with minimal face content — Mystery Dollfaces and Mystery Charm Bracelets. This is a specific-product push: keep every clip focused on these two products.
Hashtags you MUST use: #daise
Other recommended hashtags / keywords: #daisebeauty #dollfaces #blindbox #charms
Minimum engagement: 0.20% engagement or higher is always required for approval, regardless of any campaign-specific figure above.
No negative content whatsoever — do not make Daise look bad.
Clips must lean into the surprise-and-delight of the range — think blind-box reveals, "what did I get?" moments, and charms on bags.

No dedicated/branded pages for this campaign, only grown Theme Pages, UGC Creators, and Toy/Unboxing accounts above 150 followers!
THEME PAGES
If you want to participate with a Grown Theme Page, it can only be in the following niches:
Blind box / Bag charm / / Beauty / Girly / Aesthetic pages / Toys / Unboxing / ASMR pages
Account setup: NO brand names in any of your account setup — that means no "Daise," "Dollfaces," or other brand/product names in your username, display name, or bio. Name your page for its niche instead.
Content standard: Theme Pages may NEVER post gore, pornographic/OF (OnlyFans-style) content, or violent content — on the page used for this campaign or anywhere else on that page.
Must tag: @daisebeauty on TikTok / @daisebeauty on Instagram in every post
Must use a CTA pushing viewers to the product — e.g. "go find the Mystery Dollfaces!", "which charm did you get?", "link in bio!" [confirm retailer wording with ZURU].
All content must feature the Mystery Dollfaces and/or Mystery Charm Bracelets clearly and prominently — no vague or unrelated content.
Clip Style Requirements
Minimal face content: keep faces out of frame wherever possible. This creates less duplicated content at scale across all the pages in the campaign.
Show surprise & delight: the product range is about the reveal — unboxing a mystery Dollface, discovering which charm bracelet you got, charms clipped onto bags, close-ups of the details.
Product-first: hands, bags, shelves, and packaging are better than talking-head content for this campaign.

Where to Send Traffic
Walmart Link: https://www.walmart.com/ip/Daise-Blind-Box-Dollhead-with-Solid-Fragrance-Plush-Toy-With-1-1G-Solid-Fragrance/20020653093?wmlspartner=wlpa&selectedSellerId=0&wl13=2031&adid=2222222229720020653093_0000000000_23887149012&wl0=&wl1=g&wl2=c&wl3=&wl4=&wl5=9061275&wl6=&wl7=&wl8=&wl9=pla&wl10=8175035&wl11=local&wl12=20020653093&veh=sem&gclsrc=aw.ds&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=23892387002&gbraid=0AAAAADmfBIqAs8MC_3knpnKtNhqTgNGD7&gclid=EAIaIQobChMIw4idg-C6lwMVah5ECB1ahSmVEAkYASABEgJUP_D_BwE&sid=c797c50d-c1e9-409d-86f6-6e23bf7eb513 
(MUST put as link in bio to redirect viewers to buy)
Publishing Guidelines
Get your content/clips from the campaign asset pack (a selection of stills and videos — your admin will share access), or from already-existing videos of the products online.
If sourcing a clip from outside the asset pack from another creator, credit that creator by tagging them in your post.
You CANNOT do the ASMR Hook format for this campaign.
Edit your clips — trim pauses, add clear subtitles/text hooks where useful, and add trending music at low volume. No typos, spelling errors, or incorrect grammar.

For each post, the caption must tag the required account and include a CTA.
The audience must be majority US (this campaign targets the US market).
You cannot steal or re-use existing clips without modifying them in some way.

No watermarks from editing software, AI tools, etc.
Botted/fake/boosted views are PROHIBITED — this results in a permanent ban from our group and from Whop. Zero tolerance for malicious clipping.
Spelling and grammar must be correct. Sloppy content will not be tolerated or approved.

Campaign targets the US market
Need help with ideas? The client has asked for clip-able moment support — ask an admin in the support chat for angle ideas and the best moments from the asset pack.

Happy Clipping! — Clip Influence
